What if superheroes were real? Capes. Super strength. And a lot of broken buildings.
Day one. A hero saves a falling bus... and drops it right on your car.
Day two. Dad calls the insurance. Sorry. Hero damage is not covered.
Then the city sends the bill for every broken building. Taxes go up three hundred percent.
Day three. Your new neighbor is a superhero. He saves the world every day... but never takes out his trash.
It smells like a villain in here!
And that's why superheroes can never be real.
